description: Start with a task and optional hardware (e.g. "8gb-laptop"; no default — omit and fit is not evaluated), commercial and ctx constraints. Returns bounded model metadata for the task. For a catalog model it may include that model's hosted-file plan: file rows with sha256 and downloadUrl, present only when serveVerdict is READY, and no tested run command unless commandsAvailable is true. Some tasks instead return a separate Bay Run next_call. Inspect commandsAvailable, containment, blockers and null fields. A handoff does not prove catalog byte availability, local fit or model quality and does not authorize execution.

hardware.description: Free text or preset: 8gb-laptop, 16gb-laptop, cpu-only, 8gb, rtx3070-8, rtx3060-12, apple-m-16. No default.

name: find_runnable
